metadata.change_reason: Technical dependency DAG and development guidance quality standard: Strictly acyclic DAG, critical path, algorithm pseudocode, and spike validation

spec.name: Technical Dependency DAG & Development Guidance Quality Standard
spec.objective: Ensure technical dependencies form a strictly acyclic DAG, critical paths and bottlenecks are identified for engineering scheduling, and complex features have actionable pseudocode and timeboxed spikes
principles: Strictly Acyclic Dependency DAG: Component dependencies must form a directed acyclic graph; circular dependencies are strictly forbidden
Explicit Critical Path Analysis: Highlight core system bottlenecks and critical build sequence to assist engineering leads in project scheduling
Actionable Algorithm Guidance: Complex algorithms must provide concrete pseudocode and time/space complexity analysis; vague descriptions are prohibited
Explicit Spike Validation Goals: Major technical uncertainties must establish timeboxes, hypothesis validation plans, and exit criteria

review_dimensions.name: Dependency DAG Acyclicity & Clarity
review_dimensions.description: Whether the dependency graph is strictly acyclic and component relationships are unambiguous

review_dimensions.name: Critical Path Analysis Soundness
review_dimensions.description: Whether critical paths and core bottleneck identifications are accurate

review_dimensions.name: Algorithm Pseudocode & Complexity Depth
review_dimensions.description: Whether algorithm pseudocode is executable and time/space complexity is explicit

review_dimensions.name: Spike Validation Actionability
review_dimensions.description: Whether spike timeboxes and exit criteria are concrete and actionable
